targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM latest_measurements
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(temperature),0) AS value FROM latest_measurements

SELECT lm.event_timestamp, lm.device_id, d.district, d.zone_type, lm.temperature, lm.humidity, lm.battery_level FROM latest_measurements lm JOIN devices d ON d.device_id = lm.device_id ORDER BY lm.event_timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT bucket_start AS time, district AS metric, avg_temperature AS value FROM hourly_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at, alert_type, severity, district, device_id, temperature, message FROM alerts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
